// Package evalorder is an ordinary-Go oracle for goSVM's evaluation order,
// which is gc's (Go 1.22.0) order: within an expression, calls (and the
// other sequenced operations) run first, left to right, and plain operands
// are read after them (docs/ERROR_CONTRACT.md#evaluation-order). Every case
// evaluates one expression or statement in which a call writes, through a
// package variable, a pointer, a slice, an array, a map, a closure or an
// address-taken local, an operand the same expression reads; the writers
// may panic instead (a logged panic against a trap of the operand), and
// the operands may trap (an index out of range, a nil pointer or map, a
// division by zero). The same source runs natively and through goSVM;
// tests compare output bytes, results, panics and panic log lines.
//
// Run(out, in) runs case in[1] | in[2]<<8; in[3] selects the traps (bit 0:
// writers panic; 1: gi out of range; 2: gp nil; 3: gq nil; 4: gm nil; 5:
// dz zero) and in[4:] the values.
package evalorder

type T struct{ a, b uint64 }

func (t T) Val() uint64           { return t.a }
func (t T) Arg(v uint64) uint64   { return t.a*100 + v }
func (t *T) PArg(v uint64) uint64 { return t.a*100 + v }

type I interface{ M(v uint64) uint64 }

type A struct{ n uint64 }

type B struct{ n uint64 }

func (a A) M(v uint64) uint64 { return a.n*100 + v }
func (b B) M(v uint64) uint64 { return b.n*1000 + v }

// W writes little-endian results.
type W struct {
	out []byte
	o   int
}

func (w *W) u64(v uint64) {
	for j := 0; j < 8; j++ {
		w.out[w.o+j] = byte(v >> (8 * j))
	}
	w.o = w.o + 8
}

	gany       any
	dz         uint64

// step panics when the vector asks writers to panic.
func step() {
	if pw {
		panic("w")
	}
}

	return m[1]*1000 + m[2] + uint64(len(m))*1000000

func reset(in []byte) {
	pw = in[3]&1 != 0
	v1, v2, v3 = uint64(in[4]%8), uint64(in[5]%8)+10, uint64(in[6]%8)
	g = v1
	gs = []uint64{v1, v1 + 1, v1 + 2}
	gi = int(in[7] % 3)
	if in[3]&2 != 0 {
		gi = 3 + int(in[7]%2)
	}
	ga = [3]uint64{v1, v1 + 1, v1 + 2}
	gp = &T{v1, v1 + 1}
	if in[3]&4 != 0 {
		gp = nil
	}
	x := v1
	gq = &x
	if in[3]&8 != 0 {
		gq = nil
	}
	gm = map[uint64]uint64{0: v1, 1: v1 + 1, 2: v1 + 2}
	if in[3]&16 != 0 {
		gm = nil
	}
	gt = T{v1, v1 + 1}
	gstr = "ab"
	gb = []byte("ab")
	gif = A{v1}
	gfv = func(v uint64) uint64 { return v + 1 }
	gany = v1
	dz = 1
	if in[3]&32 != 0 {
		dz = 0
	}
	resetSpecial(in)
}

// dump writes every package variable's state after the case.
func dump(w *W) {
	w.u64(g)
	w.u64(uint64(len(gs)))
	for _, v := range gs {
		w.u64(v)
	}
	w.u64(uint64(gi))
	for _, v := range ga {
		w.u64(v)
	}
	if gp != nil {
		w.u64(gp.a)
		w.u64(gp.b)
	} else {
		w.u64(999)
	}
	if gq != nil {
		w.u64(*gq)
	} else {
		w.u64(999)
	}
	w.u64(uint64(len(gm)))
	w.u64(gm[0])
	w.u64(gm[1])
	w.u64(gm[2])
	w.u64(gt.a)
	w.u64(gt.b)
	w.u64(uint64(gstr[0]))
	w.u64(uint64(gb[0]))
	w.u64(gif.M(0))
	w.u64(gfv(1))
	w.u64(gany.(uint64))
	dumpSpecial(w)
}

// GeneratedCasesForTest and SpecialCasesForTest count the cases.
const (
	GeneratedCasesForTest = generatedCases
	SpecialCasesForTest   = specialCases
)

// Run runs one case and records the package state.
func Run(out, in []byte) uint64 {
	reset(in)
	w := &W{out: out}
	k := int(in[1]) | int(in[2])<<8
	if k < generatedCases {
		generated(w, k)
	} else {
		special(w, k-generatedCases)
	}
	dump(w)
	return uint64(k)
}

func Process(s, i []byte) uint64 { return Run(s, i) }
